result: Mostly a gcc problem (legacy fixincludes also rewrites stock pthread.h; upstream exempts musl, Arch and Void disable it), but libniji's headers draw 4 real rewrites from snapshot 24.2 on, and its _VA_LIST_DEFINED guard turns stdio_va_list into the va_list error; a __need_* header form removes all 4 (tested)

rulings.item: How to stop gcc fixincludes rewriting libniji's stdio.h, wchar.h, stdlib.h, unistd.h
rulings.recommendation: libniji generator emits va_list/size_t/wchar_t via the compiler's __need_* protocol (tested: 0 rewrites, same compile results); Aqours adds --disable-fixincludes as a cheap extra; do not wait for upstream gcc

informational: 'Applying' lines are not rewrites: 3 of Yohane's 8 (pthread_incomplete_struct_argument, sun_malloc, sysv68_string) also print on stock and change nothing in libniji; stock's pthread.h is rewritten
Aqours stage 1 (libc6-dev 21.4) shipped no libniji headers; its fix set matches trixie glibc 2.41's (incl. glibc_stdint), so stage 1 most likely fixed Debian glibc headers (NOT VERIFIED how)
Debian gcc-14 deletes include-fixed at install (rules2:2696) but its in-tree build uses it: libgomp fails and libstdc++ is configured without C99 stdio

impact.what: Aqours gcc-14 stage 2 (libgomp va_list, libstdc++ C99 stdio): cause found and two tested fix routes

improvement: Add 'fixincl over the installed header tree, expect no Fixed: lines' to the header probes or snapshot checks; it costs about 2 s and would have caught this at 24.2
next_step: Owner rules on option 1/2/3; if 1, change headers/stdio.h.in, wchar.h.d/020-va-list.frag, printf.h.in and the size_t/wchar_t emission, then add the fixincl check
